verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Computer runs code in a sandboxed Linux VM with Python and a persistent file workspace. They also say it processes CSV, JSON and Excel data and creates PDFs, spreadsheets and images, which covers code-driven analysis that produces computed answers and files. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of chart generation and of how users download output files, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the code-execution workflow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant write and run code on my data to produce charts, computed answers, and downloadable files

citations.quote: Computer runs code in a sandboxed Linux VM with a persistent file workspace. Python, Node.js, ffmpeg, and standard Unix tools are pre-installed
Process CSV, JSON, Excel, PDF, images, audio, and video files.
Create documents and media including PDFs, slide decks, spreadsheets, images, and videos
Analyze data from Snowflake, Databricks, Google Sheets, Salesforce, and other sources
